body:
Origin: filed by the `domain:devx` execution seat (#6023, session `session_01Vbw3RPgdtqesx4azk9SbW8`, 2026-09-06T09:15Z) from an open question raised by the #14944 Q1 B dev (PR #16271 report). ## What

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the `/pm-dispatch [args]` table (line ~60 on `origin/main` `8adb9e84a`): `| batch:<n> | 同时在飞的 dev 上限 | 3 |`. The maintainer's dispatch cap moved 3 → 5 on 2026-09-03 (recorded in #14944's ruling `5548762263`: "The nominal cap of 5 (the 2026-09-03 ruling) is unchanged"), and the execution seats run at 5 (this seat's claims read "Live devs after this claim: N/5"). The table still says 3.

Two readings are possible and the text does not say which: (A) `3` is the per-invocation default when no `batch:` argument is passed and `5` is the maintainer's ceiling — then the table is right and a sentence should say the ceiling is 5; (B) the default should follow the cap — then the cell is stale and reads `5`. Either way one line changes; today a reader of the table cannot tell which number a seat is expected to run at.

## Executable criterion

The arg table's `batch` row and the cap ruling agree in one reading, stated in the row itself (default vs ceiling), on the governed skill surface (draft PR, human merge). Provenance: #14944 ruling `5548762263` and the 2026-09-03 cap decision it cites. Note the pm-dispatch skill files are at line-ratchet headroom 0 (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`), so the change is an in-place edit of the existing row, not a new line.
